slide._note: The screen slides up from below on open and back down on close: distance_px in duration_s; it fades in over the last fade_distance_px of the slide.

puchichara_float._note: The preview puchichara bobs on a sine: its phase turns speed_deg_per_s, its height swings amplitude_px up and down.

palette_lock_flash._note: Choosing a locked palette flashes the lock message red, back to white in duration_s.
